Verdict written to `iter-05/verdict.json`.

**Overall: 93** (desktop 93, tablet 93, mobile 97)

The strip measures spec-exact almost everywhere. I verified geometry numerically off the PNGs rather than by eye: section 1440x428, 12px top/bottom padding, tile height 404px, inter-tile gaps exactly 24px, tile widths 320 / 404 / (clipped 546), border `#ECECEC` hairline, chips at 24/32/32/24 with the radial top-left scrim actually rendering (luminance falls off ~122 → ~187 from 6px to 100px out on tile 2). Chip copy reproduces the drawn `fig.01 / fig.02 / fig.03 / fig.02` including the deliberate repeat. Mobile hits `min(404px, 62vw)` = 242px with widths held to ratio, as a real snap scroller.

One genuine defect found:

- **Missing 24px gap at the marquee seam** (warning). The tile carries `last:mr-0`, which compiles to `.last\:mr-0:last-child` (specificity 0,2,0) and beats the intended `md:mr-6` override (0,1,0 — media queries add no specificity). So run 1's `fig.05` tile butts straight against run 2's `fig.01` tile with 0px between them, once per loop, while every other gap is 24px. Scoping the reset to the mobile scroller (`max-md:last:mr-0`) fixes it; the loop stays seamless either way since `-50%` still equals one run.
- Tile radius renders ~6px (Tailwind's default `rounded-md`; the theme defines `--radius-xs/-sm/-pill` but no `--radius-md`) against the spec's 8px — info-level, trivially fixed with `rounded-lg`.

The two off-token flags in `spec-match.json` (`#ECECEC` border, 32px chip padding) are spec-mandated values, so I did not count them against the build. No edits made to any project file.
